passages.note: Bill details page lists Heaton as a co-author of HJR 3, a House joint resolution defining marriage as one man and one woman.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

passages.note: House roll call 70, HJR 3 third reading, shows Heaton voting Yea; the resolution passed 57-40.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: HJR 3's operative section bars recognition of any marriage other than one man and one woman; it is silent on civil unions.

rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored and voted Yea on HJR 3 (2014), whose operative section reads 'Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana,' barring recognition of same-sex marriage and defining marriage as one man and one woman. The resolution is silent on civil unions but bars recognition, matching rung 5's text.
